# W&T Offshore to Host Live Investor Presentation via Investor Meet Company


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_1630f57ea03f35a7474036e427423311/wtoffshore/news/2026-11-11_W_T_Offshore_to_Host_Live_Investor_Presentation_511.pdf) November 11, 2026 • 6:45am EST


HOUSTON, Nov. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- W&T Offshore, Inc. (NYSE: WTI) (the “Company”) today announced that Tracy Krohn, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer will host a live investor presentation, "From Shelf to Deepwater: Meet W&T Offshore," via the Investor Meet Company platform on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Central Time (4:00 p.m. GMT).


The interactive presentation is open to all existing and potential shareholders. Questions may be submitted in advance through the Investor Meet Company dashboard until 5:00 p.m. Central Time (11:00 p.m. GMT) on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, or at any time during the live presentation.


Investors may sign up for Investor Meet Company free of charge and add W&T Offshore at:[www.investormeetcompany.com/wt-offshore-inc/register-investor](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=O-BGpHEz5qJ4KFbCLIvFxPbPAtk5YOvFPzAF8qFwbNb94x35nlfTC6IDRh9bt_2-WysFYbj1LxdYcgdBtnZPpvoE_ZSK5w_tMdbwxrKuxM4jqnW9JxcKSW5hiWKJzkLXwLbW53784ZHU-FuKfZ4rk8h-6rDXS3l-L2fj1QJISqyYJ8TGFgG6rn0Km0zxb5h8z3IRALBJLcjOOikUOG4jhdXc-csYqpPi_i4FVPpW-36d6-20nrgd9RFihdXRnjmwUZJNVE8eTyl3-YWMm8jSA5xRFSOR80o8h3VA-S6uKNQAi5hNbgbxH1qz6wjJ31DPpEy4jQgWGtBxXfVexXKuc1MXLAP64uuJKcrtlLoeLs0JGigXKGNWyWKXY09fRFmKkTwE9_A8ApVxzQFZZdlfgigFeq8Up5n-qYl_nfZs8NsCLcOIpu_YOHyn3OLT1D2wtLP04GlyBXQhs-01vJGsRGqvo4hLCJaTnaa_CSSnm9G0eqf-x5DFy2TWQ96v4WoxZx3LU0ccAkToV0-paVPaSwyoAAN5oI2dvNz40a9SCwg=) .


Investors who already follow W&T Offshore on the Investor Meet Company platform will be invited automatically.


**About W&T Offshore**


W&T Offshore, Inc. is an independent oil and natural gas producer with operations offshore in the Gulf of America and has grown through acquisitions, exploration and development. As of September 30, 2026, the Company had working interests in 48 fields in federal and state waters (which include 41 fields in federal waters and seven in state waters). The Company has under lease approximately 588,500 gross acres (455,800 net acres) spanning across the outer continental shelf off the coasts of Louisiana, Texas, Mississippi and Alabama, with approximately 446,700 gross acres on the conventional shelf, approximately 136,200 gross acres in the deepwater and 5,600 gross acres in Alabama state waters. A majority of the Company’s daily production is derived from wells it operates. For more information on W&T, please visit the Company’s website at[www.wtoffshore.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=I3X148tSC_LEFvE2L8q7r4gOVvROIv_P3J1DEPyo_aCAL4S3vIf5MGVahoMIFd5yOFeqvvKQlAU7ew5hcfSnTvl8Ia5KHhQfmUdSKigCPmk=) .
